adjudication.depicted_input: Figure 4c panel showing PROCYON-BIND fine-tuning on natural protein-peptide complexes, i.e. protein-peptide binding examples used as the binding-data input route.
adjudication.rationale: The current source figure is the correct one, and Figure 4c does support the listed route. The atlas rules explicitly allow training/fine-tuning inputs. Here the panel visibly depicts natural protein-peptide complexes being used to fine-tune PROCYON-BIND, which is the immediate representation of the paper’s stated input data ('physical protein-peptide binding data from PDBBind'). A tighter crop to panel c is better than the current wider crop because it centers the valid input path and removes unrelated panel content.
